content: Hlang Tlo Khaw Hoeih
Khohnin a di phoeiah Kapernaum la koep kun tih im ah om tila a yaak.
Te dongah muep tingtun uh tih thohka pataeng te hoeng pawh. Te vaengah amih ham ol a thui pah.
Te vaengah aka khawn te pali loh Jesuh taengla khuen ham a koh uh tih ha pawk uh.
Tedae hlangping kongah a taengla a khuen thai pawt dongah a om nah tueng kah imphu te a hlih uh. Te phoeiah a ong uh tih aka khawn te phakdoeng dongah a yalh doela a hlak uh.
Jesuh loh amih kah tangnah te a hmuh vaengah aka khawn te,

“ Balae tih anih hetla a cal, a soehsal coeng he ta. Pathen pakhat long pawt atah tholhnah aka hlah thai te unim?” tila a poek uh.
A khuiah te tla a poek uh te Jesuh loh a mueihla neh tlek a ming. Te dongah amih te, “

Thoo lamtah na phakdoeng te kawt lamtah cet

Te vaengah thoo tih hlang boeih hmaiah phakdoeng te pahoi a loh tih cet. Te dongah boeih limlum uh tih Pathen te thangpom ham, “He tlam he m'hmuh noek moenih,” a ti uh.
Mathai A Khue
Tuili kaengah koep a caeh vaengah hlangping loh a taengla boeih ha pawh uh tih amih te a thuituen.
A khum phai vaengah, mangmu doenah ah aka ngol Alphaeus capa Levi te a hmuh tih,
,” a ti nah. Te dongah thoo tih Jesuh hnuk a vai.

Hlangtholh taengah Buhvaelnah Levi im ah om tih buh a vael. Te vaengah mangmucoi rhoek neh hlangtholh rhoek tah Jesuh neh a hnukbang rhoek taengah muep ngol uh. Te phoeiah anih aka vai rhoek khaw muep om uh.

hlangtholh rhoek neh mangmucoi rhoek taengah a caak te Pharisee rhoek kah cadaek rhoek loh a hmuh uh vaengah a hnukbang rhoek taengah, “Mangmucoi rhoek neh hlangtholh rhoek taengah khaw a caak mai ke,” a ti nauh.
Jesuh loh a yaak vaengah amih te, “

content.text: Sading loh siboei ngoe pawt tih, tloh aka khueh long ni a ngoe. Aka dueng rhoek khue ham pawt tih hlangtholh rhoek ham ni ka pawk

Tuitang neh Misurtui

Johan kah hnukbang rhoek neh caak aka yaeh Pharisee rhoek tah ha pawk uh. Te vaengah cet uh tih Jesuh taengah, “Balae tih Johan kah hnukbang rhoek neh Pharisee rhoek kah hnukbang rhoek tah a yaeh uh tih na hnukbang rhoek tah a yaeh uh pawh,” a ti uh.
Jesuh loh amih te, “

content.text: Yulueihmuen kah paca boeina a om vaengah tah coeng mahpawh. Yulokung loh amih taengah a om vaengah a yaeh aya? Amih te yulokung neh a om uh tue khuiah yaeh uh thai mahpawh
Tedae khohnin a pai vaengah yulokung tah amih taeng lamkah loh a khue vetih te vaeng khohnin ah a yaeh uh bitni

content.text: Hni pen a cuemsok te himbai rhuem soah a hui moenih. Te pawt koinih a bonah rhuem te a thai loh a sol tih a pawnnah te a thae om

content: Misurtui Noe neh Rhuem

content.text: Te phoeiah misurtui noe te tuitang rhuem khuiah a than uh moenih. Te pawt koinih misurtui loh tuitang te a va vetih, misurtui khaw, tuitang khaw poci ni. Te dongah misurtui noe te tuitang a thai khuiah ni a khueh

Sabbath Boeipa
Sabbath a pha vaengah Jesuh te canghli longah van. Te vaengah a hnukbang rhoek loh longpuei ah cangvuei koe a yun uh.
Te vaengah Pharisee rhoek loh Jesuh taengah, “Sabbath ah saii tueng pawt te balae tih a saii ke,” a ti nauh.
Te dongah amih te, “

content.text: David loh a saii te na tae uh mahnim? Amah neh a taengkah rhoek loh a ngoe tih a bungpong uh vaengkah te
Khosoihham Abiathar tue vaengah Pathen im la kun tih rhungkung buh a caak te ta. Te te khosoih pawt atah a caak tueng moenih. Tedae a taengah aka om rhoek pataeng a paek pueng

content: ,” a ti nah.
Te phoeiah amih te, “

content.text: Sabbath tah hlang ham a ni a saii, tedae hlang tah Sabbath ham moenih
Te dongah Hlang Capa tah Sabbath boeipa la om pataeng
